messages:
maya: Heads-up — APAC region had a partial GPU capacity failover just before 10:30 UTC. Traffic drifted to EU/US and we lost scrape data for gpu-pool-* for ~15m. Opening an incident.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-4231 created (severity: high) :rotating_light:

samir: Prometheus shows exporter targets down. node-exporter + gpu-exporter sidecars present, but 'up' is 0 for APAC targets.

leila: OTEL logs show repeated "failed to forward: connection refused" around 10:31-10:36. Looks like egress was blocked during the region control-plane recon.

jordan: Can someone grab pods/containers? run:
```
kubectl get pods -n observability | grep otel
kubectl logs -n observability ds/otel-agent -c collector
```

samir: Running a quick PromQL to confirm:
```
# curl to query API
curl -G 'https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query' --data-urlencode 'query=up{job=~"gpu-exporter.*",region="apac"}'
# result: all zeros for 10:30-10:45
```

maya: Narrowed it down: our egress ACL reconciler flipped GRP-APAC-OBS during autoscaling, removing the metrics egress for ~8 minutes. That caused OTEL to fail forwarding and Prom scrape targets to vanish.

leila: If we re-route scrapes to eu-obs we'll keep metrics coming but lose locality graphs. Prefer to fix egress and backfill instead.

samir: Proposed immediate mitigation:
1) rollout restart otel-agent daemonset to pick up restored connectivity
2) trigger metrics backfill for the 10m gap
3) add a short-term alert for exporter scrape count

Command:
```
kubectl rollout restart ds/otel-agent -n observability
```

ops-bot: executing: kubectl rollout restart ds/otel-agent -n observability

ops-bot: rollout status: daemonset/otel-agent restarted (3/3 updated) — logs show collector started at 10:41 UTC

samir: Prometheus targets reappeared at ~10:42. We still have a 10–12 minute hole in raw metrics and traces.

maya: Backfill plan:
- Reingest metrics from metrics-archive (S3) for 10:30–10:45
- Reprocess traces from splunk/traces-archive
- Run the backfill tooling with workload tag to avoid duplicates

leila: Backfill command (internal tool):
```
./tools/obs/backfill --start=2026-03-05T10:30:00Z --end=2026-03-05T10:45:00Z --service=gpu-provisioning --dry-run=false
```

samir: Kicking the backfill job now. ETA ~ 45m. Cost estimate: ~12 GPU-hours reprocessing for trace slices (~$300) — tagging finance.

maya: Created quick PR to add an alert and a "last_success_timestamp" metric emitted by otel-agent so gaps are obvious: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/812

jordan: Action items (owners):
- prevent ACL churn during automated failover (leila)
- add last_success_timestamp metric and scrape-failure rule (samir)
- backfill metrics/traces for gap window (samir)
- add synthetic exporter probe in APAC to detect early (maya)

leila: I'll open RFC for the ACL reconciler change and schedule the rollout next week. Assigning to infra-config.

samir: Owning instrumentation change and backfill. Will post logs and cost summary in INC-4231.

maya: Status -> mitigated; monitoring. Postmortem in progress. Thanks all :heart:

deploy-bot: INC-4231 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
